opportunities.name: Plan a family call: local time + weather lookup, then draft email
opportunities.description: For a given relative, city and day: look up the city's current time and offset from Lille on timeanddate, get the 10-day forecast for that day on weather.com, then write an email to family@example.com summarising it.
steps: On timeanddate.com, click 'Search for city or place…', select all, type {city}, press Enter
Click the matching city result link (e.g. 'Country, Region, City') and read the current local time, time zone and hour offset vs Lille
On weather.com, click the location button, click 'Search for a location', type {city}, choose the matching suggestion
Click '10 Day' and read the forecast for {call_day} (conditions, high, low, chance of rain)
Open the mail compose page; type 'family@example.com' in To

Type in Body: 'Calling {relative} on {call_day}. It is {local_time} {tz} in {city} now ({offset} hours ahead/behind Lille), forecast there: {conditions} {call_day}, high {high}°F, low {low}°F, {rain}% chance of rain.'
Finish the draft (the user clicked Discard each time; Send would be the normal end)

instances.values: city=Montreal, relative=Grandma Rose, day=Sunday (13:58 EDT, -6h, high 49°F, low 39°F, 4% rain)
city=Sydney, relative=Uncle Ben, day=Saturday (05:02 AEDT, +9h, high 68°F, low 58°F, 24% rain)
city=Singapore, relative=Aunt Mei, day=Friday (02:09 SGT, +6h, high 91°F, low 79°F, 44% rain)

opportunities.name: Research a weekend stopover: Wikipedia + Booking.com hotel, then log a note
opportunities.description: For a given French city and weekend date: read the city's Wikipedia page for population and a landmark, search Booking.com for a one-night stay, open the top hotel, and add a 'Stopover' note.
steps: On Wikipedia, click 'Search Wikipedia', type {city}, press Enter; note the population and a main sight
On Booking.com, click 'Enter destination', select all, type {city}, choose the city suggestion
Open the date picker, go to the next month as needed, click check-in {date} and check-out {date+1}
Open the top-listed hotel and note its name and nightly price
In the Notes app, click 'New note', type 'Stopover {city} {date}: {hotel} €{price}. See {sight} (pop {population})', press Enter

instances.values: city=Dijon, Nov 21–22 2026 → Aparthotel Adagio Access Dijon République €69, historical centre, pop 161,830
city=Reims, Dec 19–20 2026 → Best Western Premier Hotel de la Paix €204, Reims Cathedral, pop 177,674
city=Annecy, Feb 13–14 2027 → Moxy Annecy €120, Lake Annecy, pop 132,117

opportunities.name: Dinner plan: OpenTable restaurant vs Allrecipes recipe, then log a note
opportunities.description: For a given cuisine and London area: search OpenTable for a restaurant and Allrecipes for a matching dish, pick the top result of each, and add a 'Dinner: out at X or cook Y' note.
steps: On OpenTable, click the 'Location, Restaurant or Cuisine' box, select all, type '{cuisine} {area}', press Enter
Open the top restaurant and note its name, rating, price band and neighbourhood
On Allrecipes, click 'Find a recipe or ingredient', type {dish}, press Enter
Open the top recipe result and note its total time
In the Notes app, click 'New note', type 'Dinner: out at {restaurant} ({rating}, {price}, {area}) or cook {recipe} ({time})', press Enter

instances.values: Italian Islington → Terra Rossa - Angel (4.7, £26–£40); lasagna → Creamy Chicken Lasagna (1 hr 30 mins)
Thai Soho → Thai Tho - Soho (4.3, £26–£40); pad thai → Pad Thai (45 mins)
Indian Shoreditch → SPICE SLICE Shoreditch (1.3, £25 and under); chicken tikka masala → Chicken Tikka Masala (2 hrs 20 mins)
